race.comment: DALGETY (1) used the rails draw to advantage to get home last time at Q Parklands over 600m (34.69) after forging to the front and leading throughout, scoring by one length. Rates on top from the rails draw again. BENTLEY KRISTOFF (3) boasts a strong record this course with seven wins and four minors from 15 tries. Hit the frame latest (35.12) when second at Q Parklands in a Grade 5. Makes strong appeal on best. SIRONEN TIGER (7) shapes as hard to beat after winning last start over the 550m at this track in a respectable 30.44. Harder here but will be in this for a long way. PENNY CALIDO (2) looks an each-way chance.
